**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, minimum volume, or take-or-pay obligation binding the Company:

- **§3.1 (Fees)** — the only payment obligation is 30% of Net Sales *in excess of* $11,000 per calendar month. This is purely transaction-based; the $11,000 threshold operates in our favour as a floor below which nothing is owed, not as a minimum spend.
- **§4.1 (Term)** — one-year term with annual auto-renewal, terminable by either Party on 90 days' notice; **§1.6** gives us an additional unilateral termination right without penalty if the Site is not operational within 70 days. No multi-year lock-in.
- No "shortfall", "minimum", or committed-volume language appears anywhere in the document.

Two adjacent points noted in the rationale but not flagged under this rule (to avoid double-counting commercial terms):
- **§4.2 Termination Payment** — if we terminate, we owe half of trailing 12-month Net Sales less $800,000. This is an exit cost, not a purchase commitment, and belongs to the termination-fee rule.
- **§6.1 Exclusivity** — restricts the Company from similar Deerskin internet projects; an exclusivity issue rather than a volume cap on usage.
